question.text: The maximum number of investors permitted in a single AIF scheme is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SEBI (AIF) Regulations, the maximum number of investors in a single scheme of an AIF shall not exceed 1,000. This cap preserves the private-placement character of the fund and distinguishes it from public pooling vehicles such as mutual funds. The Trap: The 1,000-investor limit is per scheme, not per fund. An AIF can run multiple schemes, each subject to the same per-scheme cap and the same INR 1 crore minimum commitment requirement. Note: Angel Funds, a sub-category of Category I Venture Capital Funds, are subject to a separate cap of up to 200 angel investors per scheme rather than the standard 1,000-investor limit.
